# Lab 17.3: Egress Controls & Usage Metrics

## What We Are Going to Do
Stop subscribers from copying or exporting shared data, and see who is using your listing.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Turn on egress controls.** Edit the listing → **Data egress controls** → tick **Disable copy and export of shared data** and **Restrict query result egress**. Save.

2. **[SQL] Test from the partner project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE my_copy AS SELECT * FROM partner_sales.daily_category_sales;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   This fails with an egress-restriction error. Simple `SELECT` queries still work.

3. **[CLI] Try an export from the partner project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --project_id=$PARTNER extract partner_sales.daily_category_sales gs://some-bucket/x.csv</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   This also fails.

4. **[Console] Read usage metrics.** In the publisher project, open the listing → **Usage metrics**. See subscribers, number of jobs and bytes scanned on your shared data.

5. **[SQL] Query usage with SQL.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT *
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SHARED_DATASET_USAGE
ORDER BY job_start_time DESC
LIMIT 20;</span>
</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Copy / export | Blocked for subscribers |
| SELECT | Still allowed |
| Usage metrics | Jobs and bytes by subscriber |
| View | `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SHARED_DATASET_USAGE` |
